WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.equipstatus,
    t.telescregistry,
    AVG(s.pulsepersec) as telescope_avg_pulse
  FROM signals s
  INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus, t.telescregistry
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    equipstatus,
    AVG(telescope_avg_pulse) as status_avg_pulse
  FROM step1
  GROUP BY equipstatus
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg_pulse) as mean1 FROM step2
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    step2.equipstatus,
    step2.status_avg_pulse,
    step2.status_avg_pulse - first_mean.mean1 as excess1
  FROM step2
  CROSS JOIN first_mean
  WHERE step2.status_avg_pulse > first_mean.mean1
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg_pulse) as mean2 FROM step3
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    step3.equipstatus,
    step3.status_avg_pulse,
    step3.excess1,
    step3.status_avg_pulse - second_mean.mean2 as excess2
  FROM step3
  CROSS JOIN second_mean
  WHERE step3.status_avg_pulse > second_mean.mean2
)
SELECT
  AVG(status_avg_pulse) as final_avg_pulse,
  AVG(excess1) as avg_excess_over_first,
  AVG(excess2) as avg_excess_over_second
FROM step4
